Application assessment

Turn interest into an engineering question.

An initial assessment connects your commercial objective to the vessel, manoeuvre and operating environment.

  • Vessel or floating-asset particulars
  • Target manoeuvre and required thrust
  • Environmental loads and operating envelope
  • Deployment, recovery and energy duty
  • Control concept, infrastructure and approvals

What you receive

An initial view of the likely Towbot class, the principal technical questions, information gaps and a practical next step for feasibility, pilot development or integration.
